metadata.attribution: Illustrative AC-access sample for the swelter demo network.
metadata.source: Illustrative sample placed on the synthetic demo network's published grid cells. NOT real LACE data. A real deployment replaces this with U.S. Census Bureau Local Air Conditioning Estimates (LACE) tract-level data for its actual jurisdiction, joined by geocoding each published cell to its census tract — see docs/decisions/0014-exposure-brief-and-equity-context.md.
